titulo.alumno: A plan that changes · Telling events in order

intro: Part 2: a plan that changes. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: A narrative organises events with «først», «bagefter» and «til sidst». Check what happened before and what changed afterwards; the order of the sentences does not always match the time order.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
